leo1a5dk.name: Leopard 1A5 DK
leo1a5dk.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): Leopard 1A5 DK at tier I, a photo-class first-party build with its Danish kit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
leo1a5dk.envelopeBasis: Width is the as-built X extent over the skirts (published 3.41 m). Length is the as-built Z extent, the published 9.54 m with the gun forward plus the bow eyes and stern carriers. Tallest is the whip tips as built; the published 2.8 m over the commander's MG is held by the fixture. The EMES 18 box, the raised PERI R12 and the blanked rangefinder ports follow the Aalborg museum's 1A5 DK turret (Wikimedia Commons).
